description: check_name_constraints signature (line 1365): nc_permitted: &Option<x509_cert::ext::pkix::constraints::name::GeneralSubtrees>. Idiomatic Rust passes Option<&T> when you only need to read the inner value, not &Option<T>. &Option<T> forces the callee to dereference through the outer reference before doing anything with the Option. The callers at line 1234 pass &nc_permitted (reference to a local Option), which compiles but is anti-idiomatic. Should be nc_permitted: Option<&...GeneralSubtrees> with callers passing nc_permitted.as_ref(). This applies to nc_excluded too (line 1366) but there it's &GeneralSubtrees which is fine since GeneralSubtrees is always present.
title: check_name_constraints takes &Option<GeneralSubtrees> instead of Option<&GeneralSubtrees>
